leadText:
We Are The One is the ending theme for the Korean dub of the Rayquaza Rising arc and the third of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ068, replacing Make You Shine. It uses the same animation as its corresponding Japanese ending theme, Sparkle!.

The full version of the song was released as a digital single on April 15, 2025.
